label: Idealista Scraper
title: Idealista Scraper by Filters: Spain, Portugal & Italy
metaDescription: Scrape Idealista without URLs: pick a place, buy or rent and 140+ filters for homes, rooms, offices, premises, garages and land in Spain, Portugal and Italy.
intro: Search Idealista Spain, Portugal and Italy with filters instead of links: type a place, choose buy or rent and the property type, and tick the filters you need (price, size, bedrooms, condition, energy rating, 27 features and more). Covers all 10 Idealista property types, including rooms, offices, premises, garages and land, and splits big areas into districts to get past the 2,500-listing cap.
useCases: Collect every listing in a city that matches your filters, past the 2,500-listing cap
Track new listings and price drops in a district every day
Research rooms, offices, premises or land, not just homes

faq.q: How is this different from Idealista Scraper API?
faq.a: This one needs no links: you fill a form with a place and filters, for all 10 property types in Spain, Portugal and Italy. Idealista Scraper API takes Idealista links (search, drawn map, multi-zone or a single property) and also covers France.

faq.q: Do I need an Idealista link?
faq.a: No. Type a town, district or province as written on Idealista (for example Madrid, Chamberí, Lisboa or Milano) and pick the filters. A filter that does not exist for your property type is skipped and noted in the log.

140+ options, as in the Idealista app: price, size, bedrooms, bathrooms, condition, occupancy (vacant, tenanted, bare ownership…), floor, energy rating, 27 features, listing extras and publication date, plus filters for rooms, offices, premises and land.

faq.q: Can I get a whole city past the 2,500-listing cap?
faq.a: Yes. Large areas are split into districts and neighbourhoods automatically, without duplicates.
Listings are collected by the Idealista Scraper API engine in your account at its per-listing price ($0.003 each on the free plan), plus a small fee per location searched from 2026-12-01.

officialApi: Idealista's official API is granted on request, mainly to partners, with low request quotas and fewer fields than the website. This actor needs no API key and returns what Idealista shows, with every filter of its app.
